links.outcome: Radiologist diagnostic accuracy unaided versus with AI assistance across experience levels
links.effect: AI assistance significantly improved accuracy across all experience levels; with combined model, seniors reached 75.4-79.0% in internal validation and up to 85.4% in hardest external cohort, ~30% absolute gain over unaided.
links.quote: In the reader study with 315 lesions and five radiologists, AI assistance significantly improved diagnostic accuracy across all experience levels.

links.outcome: Model performance across multiple sites/external cohorts
links.effect: Combined model achieved AUCs of 0.818 (EVC1) and 0.899 (EVC2) in the external validation cohorts, outperforming single-modality approaches.
links.quote: The combined model outperformed all single-modality approaches across validation cohorts, achieving AUCs of 0.818 (EVC1) and 0.899 (EVC2) with balanced sensitivity and specificity (EVC2: 0.929 and 0.833, respectively).

screen.reason: The study conducts a multi-reader study comparing diagnostic accuracy and consensus among radiologists with and without AI assistance.
